item.title: Cornell president calls gang rape allegations 'deeply disturbing'
item.description: Cornell president Michael I. Kotlikoff said the university "must do better" in a video statement, calling it a defining moment in Cornell's history.

item.title: Cornell case affects women who have experienced sexual assault
item.description: Rape allegations from a Cornell University frat house are prompting many women to recall their own experiences and call for action.

item.title: Family of Fox News journalist killed in Ukraine sues network
item.description: Relatives of two Fox News journalists killed in Ukraine are suing the network, alleging it prioritized the story over their safety.

item.title: Trump appoints Jay Clayton as new AI czar
item.description: Trump said Clayton will lead the White House's new "Super Intelligence Force," coordinating government engagement with artificial intelligence.
